definitions.explanation: The act of surrounding something or someone on all sides, whether in a military, police, or figurative context.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{包囲|ほうい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{包囲|ほうい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三方|さんぽう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{包囲|ほうい}⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{補給|ほきゅう}→補給：14055_hokyuu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{断|た}たれた→断つ：27885_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: The castle was besieged from three sides, and food supplies were also cut off.

notes:
Composed of {包|ほう} (wrap/enclose) and {囲|い} (surround). Describes the tactical or physical act of surrounding something. Common in military history, news reports about police operations, and figurative expressions about being cornered.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {包囲|ほうい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to surround, to besiege
- {包囲|ほうい}{網|もう}: encirclement net, cordon
- {包囲|ほうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突破|とっぱ}する→突破する：25363_toppasuru⟧: to break through an encirclement
- {包囲|ほうい}⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧: siege attack
- {包囲|ほうい}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be surrounded

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧: to surround — the everyday verb for surrounding
- ⟦{取|と}り{囲|かこ}む→取り囲む：20925_torikakomu⟧: to surround / to encircle — emphasizes closing in from all sides
- ⟦{封鎖|ふうさ}→封鎖：18846_fuusa⟧: blockade — focuses on blocking access rather than surrounding

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
Do not confuse with ⟦{方位|ほうい}→方位：13047_houi⟧ (compass direction/bearing), which has the same reading.
